nodes.label: Bollinger Bands Example Chart
nodes.description: Candlestick chart titled 'Bollinger Bands (20, 2)' showing EUR/USD price action (~1.0775-1.0975) with three overlays: blue MA 20 (middle band), purple upper band (+2σ), and purple lower band (-2σ). The shaded region between bands illustrates band expansion during a trending move and contraction during consolidation. Labels are in Russian (Цена = Price, Верхняя полоса = Upper band, Нижняя полоса = Lower band). X-axis shows ~100 candles.

nodes.label: MA 20 (Moving Average 20)
nodes.description: Blue line representing the 20-period simple moving average, the middle band of the Bollinger Bands indicator.

nodes.label: Upper Bollinger Band (+2σ)
nodes.description: Purple line representing MA 20 plus two standard deviations, forming the upper boundary of the Bollinger Bands channel.

nodes.label: Lower Bollinger Band (-2σ)
nodes.description: Purple line representing MA 20 minus two standard deviations, forming the lower boundary of the Bollinger Bands channel.

nodes.label: EUR/USD Candlestick Price Data
nodes.description: Red and green OHLC candlesticks showing EUR/USD price action ranging approximately from 1.0775 to 1.0975 over ~100 periods.
